# QR Code generator library

`qrcodegen.js` is the unmodified ES2015 JavaScript build of Project Nayuki's
QR Code generator library, version 1.8.0, under the MIT License.
The full license is preserved at the top of the source file.

- Project: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Download: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/download/v1.8.0/qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js
- SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`

`install-qr.js` is Spiral's SVG rendering wrapper. QR generation runs locally;
neither script requests a remote service or transmits the encoded URL.
